title: Robot Task Annotation
description: Schema for a structured robot arm manipulation task annotation used in VLA (Vision-Language-Action) model training data.

video_id.description: Identifier for the source video (omitted or anonymized in public examples).

intent.description: One to two sentences describing the overall goal of the arm's movement, first-person voice.

subtasks_summary.description: Ordered list of atomic, first-person motion steps.

final_summary.description: Standalone narrative paragraph recapping the task from start to end state.

outcome_rationale.description: Justification for the outcome label, referencing specific visual evidence rather than restating the label.
